policy.personal_data: No vault content except explicit contract allowlist. No selfweb/site/content or public. No growth runtime data.
policy.git: No .git directories or objects; only sanitized metadata. Current included file bytes preserve staged/unstaged/untracked content. Deletion statuses recorded.
policy.credential_scan: All candidate text scanned in memory before copying. Only file paths and rule names emitted; matching values never logged. Suspected files entirely excluded.
policy.limits: Heuristic scan cannot prove absence of all secrets. Binary media limited to small source icons/fonts; unknown binaries excluded. Directory exclusions pruned, not enumerated.
project_specific: selfweb output reports work site/content site/public excluded
